name: Uncoupled Parallel BTT LOD
aliases: Uncoupled Parallel View Dependent Level of Detail Rendering
Uncoupled Parallel View Dependent Level of Detail Rendering of Bintree Triangulations
definition: A parallel method for rendering terrain meshes using bintree triangulations (BTT) that splits the mesh into two halves to allow independent refinement on separate processors, balancing processor load by identifying patches at each side of the observer.
